posts.text:
Happy Mother’s Day to Jane and to all of the mothers around the world. 

Let us continue our push for a world where all mothers can raise their families without the threat of war, with economic stability and where their rights are protected.

Massive wealth inequality is a global crisis.

The world’s 3,000 billionaires got $2.5 trillion richer last year & now hold $18.3T.

The 12 richest people own more wealth than the bottom half of humanity.

Our goal: create a global economy that works for ALL, not just the few.

The Trump Administration says the war in Iran will cost $25 billion.

That’s a lie.

This war could cost over $1 trillion—thousands of dollars for every household in America.

Invest in housing, education, and health care—not illegal and unconstitutional wars.

END THIS WAR NOW.

The past three years were the hottest three years in recorded history.

The past eleven years were the hottest eleven years in recorded history.

Trump thinks climate change is a “hoax.” He is dangerously wrong.

We must break our addiction to fossil fuels and save the planet.

During Teacher Appreciation Week, remember this: If we want the best-educated workforce in the world, we need great teachers.

But we won’t attract great teachers when the average starting salary is just $48K a year.

My Pay Teachers Act guarantees teachers at least $60K a year.

Trump and his family have now made $4 BILLION off the presidency, including more than $3 billion from crypto alone.
 
Here’s a radical idea. What about having a president who wants to improve the financial well-being of ALL Americans, not just his own family and fellow oligarchs.

Maybe, just maybe, the Trump administration is beginning to face reality.

After months of resisting all forms of regulation, they have finally acknowledged that out-of-control AI is a danger to humanity and must be regulated.


Diego Areas Munhoz (@Dareasmunhoz)

And here's what HASSETT told Bartiromo today about the coming EO: 

New models "should go through a process so that they’re released to the wild after they’ve been proven safe, just like an FDA drug.”

Trump admin treating new AI model

We have more income and wealth inequality in America than ever before.
 
Meanwhile, we rank 34th in the world in childhood poverty, 20% of our seniors live on $15,000 a year or less and 800,000 Americans are homeless.
 
We need a fundamental change in our national priorities NOW.

The reality of American life today: Jeff Bezos, worth $290 billion, spent:

$10 million on the Met Gala
$120 million on a penthouse
$500 million on a yacht

Meanwhile, he‘s planning to throw 600,000 Amazon workers out on the streets and replace them with robots.

Unacceptable.

Big Oil is making a $30 million windfall profit every HOUR by using the Iran War as an excuse to rip off commuters at the gas pump.

This year, Exxon will be spending $20 billion of its profits on stock buybacks.

We must end the Iran War and pass a windfall profits tax — NOW!

In 1933, Justice Louis Brandeis said: “We can have democracy in this country or we can have great wealth concentrated in the hands of the few, but we cannot have both.”

What he said was true 93 years ago. It’s even more accurate today.

Let us choose democracy over oligarchy.
My op-ed in the @latimes: latimes.com/opinion/story/20…

While the billionaires get much richer, 60% of working class Americans struggle to afford food or housing. Millions are losing healthcare.

Yes. The very rich should start paying their fair share of taxes. That’s why I support the California Wealth Tax on billionaires.

This is what kleptocracy looks like:
 
Last year, Meta gave Trump $25 million to settle a bogus lawsuit & $1 million for his inauguration.
 
This year, Trump gave Meta an $8 billion tax break lowering its tax rate to -23% this quarter.
 
That's a pretty good return on investment.

The world’s leading scientists are warning that AI could “end civilization as we know it.”
 
97% of Americans believe AI safety should be subject to rules.
 
When will our government wake up?! We need global cooperation — before it’s too late.

Video

I enjoyed speaking with hunger and nutrition advocates from Vermont this week. In the richest country in the history of the world, nobody should be going hungry. 

I thank these advocates for their tireless efforts.

The people building AI admit they may not be able to control it.

This is not science fiction—this is what experts are telling us.

That’s why I’m bringing together leading AI scientists from the U.S. and China to discuss the risks posed by AI. nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1MJgNgYoo…

Ex-OpenAI board member Helen Toner says AI companies are "deadly serious" about building machines that outperform humans at everything and they don’t know if they’ll be able to control them.
 
So why hasn’t Congress taken meaningful action to regulate AI?

Video

The FCC is now threatening ABC's broadcast licenses, days after Donald Trump and Melania Trump demanded they fire Jimmy Kimmel.

This is straight out of the authoritarian playbook.

Mr. President: Read the Constitution. Freedom of speech is the First Amendment for good reason.

Young people in Vermont and across the country are, for good reasons, worried about the future.

Our job: make it better.

Video
We are not ready for what’s coming.
Adam Hamawy was a 9/11 first responder, a combat trauma surgeon in Iraq & a volunteer in Gaza.
Americans don’t want their taxpayer dollars funding genocide.
Billionaires should not be able to buy elections. Overturn Citizens United.
FULL SPEECH: Bernie discusses the existential threat of AI and endless war in Ohio
Jeff Bezos is seeking $100 billion to automate factories. His whole goal is to replace human labor.
A disaster for working people.
There’s only a 10% chance that humanity is destroyed.
A better future is possible.
LIVE: Fighting Oligarchy in Detroit, MI with Abdul El Sayed, Donavan McKinney and Sara Nelson

In the richest country on earth, young people shouldn't have to wait until age 40 to buy a home - 12 years after first-time buyers in 1991. Young people shouldn't have to fear a lower standard of living than their parents. We need an economy that works for all, not just the 1%.

In the United States we need hundreds of new hospitals and health clinics. We need thousands of new child care centers. We need millions of new units of affordable housing. We do NOT need to spend another $500 billion on the military for endless wars.

Jeff Bezos is seeking $100 billion to put robots into factories. Millions of manufacturing jobs — GONE. Driverless vehicle companies are expanding rapidly. Millions of transportation jobs — truckers, cab drivers, Uber drivers — GONE. We are not ready for what’s coming.

Since Trump launched the war on Iran, gas prices have jumped from $2.98 to $4.55 a gallon.   Working families can’t afford that. We need to invest in the needs of the American people, not spend billions on an unconstitutional war.
It’s time to overturn Citizens United and stop billionaires from buying our elections.

Google founder Sergey Brin's wealth has DOUBLED to $311 billion since Trump's election.   Now he’s spending $57M to oppose a 5% billionaires' wealth tax in California.   He’d rather millions lose healthcare than pay his fair share in taxes. This kind of arrogance is unacceptable.
A disaster for working people.
